# pgdesign codegen

Generate type-safe application code from schema definitions

**Effect:** mutating

## Flags

| Name | Short | Type | Presence | Env | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--lang` |  | str | required |  | Target programming language for the generated code Values: `python` (generate Python source), `zig` (generate Zig source), `go` (generate Go source), `ts` (generate TypeScript source), `java` (generate Java source), `kotlin` (generate Kotlin source). |
| `--mode` |  | str | optional |  | Code generation mode determining what code to produce; omitted means validators Values: `constants` (table and column name string constants), `constraints` (client-side validators derived from CHECK, NOT NULL and enum constraints), `ddl` (DDL definition tuples plus a section executor that applies them), `drizzle` (a Drizzle ORM schema module), `enums` (standalone enum definitions for the schema's enum types), `gorm` (GORM struct tags for the schema's tables), `jpa` (JPA entity classes for the schema's tables), `query-layer` (Protocol definitions with an asyncpg backend and an in-memory backend), `sqlalchemy` (SQLAlchemy 2.0 declarative models), `types` (native struct, class or interface definitions with their enums), `validators` (row-level-security policy checkers). |
| `--output` |  | str | optional |  | Write output to a file at this path instead of stdout |
| `--split-mode` |  | str | optional |  | How to split multi-file Python DDL output Values: `faceted` (write one file per object kind), `self-contained` (emit a single importable module). |
| `--groups` |  | list[str] (unique) | optional |  | Restrict generation to tables in these schema groups (matches build's per-output group filtering) |
| `--source` |  | list[str] (unique) | optional |  | Restrict generation to tables from these source file basenames (matches build's per-output source filtering) |
| `--check`, `--no-check` |  | bool | optional |  | Verify generated code on disk is up to date without writing anything; requires --output, exits 1 on any missing, stale, or orphan file; omitted means the code is written |

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Presence | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | list[str] (variadic) | required | Path to TOML schema file(s) or directory containing them |
